meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

copy.tagline: 统筹多个 AI 工人,分步交接并监督任务执行进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把复杂任务拆给多个 AI 工人,并保持过程可控可见。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate several AI workers to split tasks and oversee step-by-step progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage several AI assistants and want visible, controlled delegation across them.

howto.what: Claude 会协调多个受监督的 Orca worker:线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、任务派发、等待 worker_done 或升级、任务 DAG、决策门与协调循环。它会先为本次会话选定 CLI,再加载版本匹配的指南后执行命令。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化多智能体协调(任务派发、任务 DAG、决策门等)时接管;若只是要求移交所有权(如「hand off」)且未要求监督或等待结果,就改用 orca-cli。

say.text: 帮我把这组工作拆成任务 DAG 并派发给各个 worker
say.note: 先加载版本匹配的指南再派发

say.text: 派发一个任务,然后等 worker_done 或升级信号
say.note: 阻塞等待 worker 完成或上报

say.text: 把这条消息发给正在运行的 worker

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done or escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops. It resolves the CLI, then loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: It engages for multi-agent coordination such as task dispatch, task DAGs, or decision gates. If the user only asks for an ownership handoff like "hand off" without supervision, use orca-cli.

say_en.text: Break this work into a task DAG and dispatch it to the workers
say_en.note: Loads the version-matched guide, then dispatches

say_en.text: Dispatch a task, then wait for the worker_done or an escalation
say_en.note: Blocks until the worker reports done or escalates

say_en.text: Send this message to the running worker
say_en.note: Posts a threaded message to that worker
